art.subject: Mongolian Finch (Bucanetes mongolicus), adult male in spring, a vagrant on a dry rocky hillside in Korea: crown, nape and ear coverts plain sandy grey-brown; lores, the area around the eye and a faint supercilium washed pink; mantle sandy brown with faint diffuse dark streaks; throat and breast sandy-buff washed rose-pink, the pink extending onto the flanks; belly whitish; wings brown with pink edges to the flight feathers and a pale whitish panel formed by the pale-edged greater coverts and secondaries; tail dark brown with pale feather edges. Bill stout, conical, pale yellowish-horn; eye dark; legs pink to orange-pink.
art.pose: feeding on the ground among stones, side view
art.scene: dry, stony coastal hillside with sparse grass in Korea in spring (April), bright light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male in spring, side view standing on stones: short stout greyish-yellow bill, pink flush on the face with sandy-brown ear coverts, sandy-brown crown and mantle with fine brown streaks, sandy breast washed pink along the flanks, wing with white patches at the bases of the greater coverts and secondaries, notched tail, brownish-pink legs

adult female, side view standing on the ground: plain sandy-brown bird with only a faint pink tinge, short stout pale bill, fainter white patches on the greater coverts and secondaries, notched brown tail
art.build: A small, compact desert finch about the size of a sparrow, with a large rounded head, short neck and medium-length notched tail; feeds quietly on the ground among stones. No crest; the crown feathers lie flat. Bill short, deep and conical, pale yellowish-horn, shorter than the head. Legs short, pink to orange-pink. In flight the pale wing panel and the pinkish wash show; there are no bold wing bars.
avoid: Do not paint a red or scarlet bird like a male Common Rosefinch; the pink is a soft wash on a sandy-brown bird.
Do not paint a dark or blackish bill; it is pale yellowish-horn.
Do not paint bold white wing bars; the pale area is a panel on the greater coverts and secondaries.
Do not paint a long tail (Long-tailed Rosefinch).
